title: SvgG
responsibility: Renders the native g element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgG.attributes
inputs.description: Native g attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgG.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native g element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgG
outputs.description: The actual native g element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
